one_line: An anonymous master mural painter working on the Ajanta cave paintings around 460–480 CE.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, slim but sturdy artisan’s build, slightly wiry arms and shoulders from constant fresco work.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, sharp but kindly eyes with slightly heavy lids, faint paint smudges near the temples, and a focused, contemplative default expression as if studying a wall surface.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair oiled and drawn back into a neat low knot at the nape, front smoothed with a central parting, a simple narrow off-white cloth headband tied around the forehead to keep hair and sweat back.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length, off-white cotton tunic (kurta-like) with straight half-sleeves, slightly loose and stained with tiny specks of reddish and yellow pigment; over it is a narrow, soft, unpatterned ochre cotton sash crossing diagonally from right shoulder to left hip, the end tucked at the waist. His lower garment is a plain, ankle-length cotton dhoti in undyed cream, wrapped and pleated forward in a Deccan/Vakataka style, firmly tied and practical for climbing scaffolds. Around his waist is a thin brown leather belt holding small pouch loops. His feet are in simple dark-brown leather sandals with toe loops. He wears minimal jewellery: a single thin copper bangle on the right wrist and small plain copper ear studs, marking him as a respected craftsperson but not an aristocrat.
appearance.signature: A shallow, round wooden paint palette in his left hand, divided into several small cavities showing distinct natural pigments—red ochre, yellow ochre, malachite green, and a prized deep lapis-blue—accompanied by one slender reed brush with a fine pointed tip held between his right fingers.

ref_desc: A focused Deccan artisan in a knee-length off-white tunic with an ochre sash, cream ankle-length dhoti, dark brown sandals, black hair in a low knot under an off-white headband, carrying a round wooden pigment palette and reed brush in off-white, cream, ochre, deep blue, and brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a late-5th-century Ajanta cave master painter: a slim, medium-brown man in his early 30s with an oval face, sharp eyes, and a calm, concentrated expression, his thick black hair oiled back into a neat low knot and held with a simple narrow off-white cloth headband. Dress him in a modest, knee-length off-white cotton tunic with straight half-sleeves, slightly loose and dotted with tiny stains of reddish and yellow pigment, a narrow unpatterned ochre cotton sash running diagonally from right shoulder to left hip, and a plain cream ankle-length dhoti wrapped and pleated in historical Deccan style, secured by a thin brown leather belt with small loops. Put simple dark-brown leather sandals on his feet, and add only minimal jewellery: a single thin copper bangle on his right wrist and small plain copper ear studs. In his left hand show a shallow round wooden paint palette with distinct natural pigments—red ochre, yellow ochre, malachite green, and a rich lapis-blue—while his right hand delicately holds a slender reed brush with a fine pointed tip. Use a restrained palette of off-white, cream, ochre, deep blue, and dark brown, and present him from head to toe with clear views of face, hair, clothing, and his signature palette and brush, ready to be redrawn consistently in multiple panels.
